title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Warhammer Age of Sigmar shows exactly where that breaks. Warhammer Age of Sigmar is a miniature wargame produced by Games Workshop that simulates battles between armies by using miniature figurines. Games are typically played on a relatively flat surface such as a dining table, bespoke gaming table, or an area of floor.

The selfish-gene reading of Warhammer Age of Sigmar makes it less romantic and far more precise. Led by Orpheon Katakros, the Mortarch of the Necropolis, and Arkhan the Black, the Mortarch of Sacrament.
